card.name: Linking words before time or cause nouns
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as "of", "possible" and "for" that come right before a noun naming a stage, event or cause. Typical spots are "the time of ovulation", "the period of organogenesis" and "in case of intoxication".

modes.label: "of" after time nouns
modes.description: The word "of" follows "time", "period" or "case" and leads into an event or condition.
modes.example: Dexrazoxane administration during the period<< of>> organogenesis resulted in maternal toxicity

modes.label: "possible" before underlying cause
modes.description: The word "possible" or "for" comes before a suspected cause that should be checked.
modes.example: Reevaluate patients with unresponsive cough in 5 days or sooner for<< possible>> underlying pathology.

card.writes: No clear link between the promoted words and a single output effect; they hint at sequence and stage words (sequential, respective, reversible).
card.plain: It marks small linking words like "of" or "possible" that sit just before a stage, event or suspected cause.
